Class CliElement

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.view.cli.cliElements.CliElement
Direct Known Subclasses:
CliAdventureCard, CliAllShips, CliComponent, CliComponentBank, CliComponentLegend, CliFlightBoard, CliForecast, CliForecastCards, CliHand, CliShipBoard, CliStash
public abstract class CliElement extends Object
Represents a generic CLI element that can be described. It caches the description to avoid recomputing it unnecessarily.

      public final List<String> getDescription()
      Returns the cached description of this element. If the description is dirty, it recomputes it and updates the cache, calling getNewDescription() to get the new description.
      Returns:
      A list of strings representing the description of this element
